independence_boundary: Reviewed the frozen partial payload only. This is not final C3 acceptance, not a rerun of provider work, and not an approval of the cancelled Grok recovery run.

findings.observation: The exact twelve master-plan families are present once, in the intended 5/4/3 mapping: HRSA AHRF, NPPES, SAMHSA, CMS T-MSIS/TAF and CDC/ATSDR SVI to PR-043; PHC4, state APCD, state facility licensure and rural hospital closure tracking to PR-044; AHRQ HCUP, AHRQ MEPS and AHA Annual Survey to PR-045. Each family carries C-<n>-1, C-<n>-2 and C-<n>-3 intake commit names. The family set is still an intake pointer frame, so this does not satisfy R09.

All twelve family records set locator_status=unverified_locator, publisher_access_claimed=false and schema_qualification_claimed=false, and retain family-specific unknowns. The state APCD pointer is marked a secondary navigation directory; the state-licensure pointer is explicitly federal certification context rather than state-license evidence; TAF, HCUP, MEPS and AHA restrictions/unknown terms remain visible. The copied publisher and candidate_official_locator fields at c3_lib.py:632-636 remain semantically safe only while consumers honor this frame; they are not independently verified source assertions.
findings.required_correction: Before any public route publication, retain an explicit candidate/unverified publisher identity state (or equivalent consumer contract) so downstream cards cannot render copied publisher/locator fields as verified. PR-043/044/045 must promote them only after their own evidence-backed intake checks.

findings.observation: The exact ordered 25 hospital and 10 payer IDs match the C3 build receipt, are unique, and remain in later denominators. freeze_before_endpoint_results=true and endpoint_results_seen=false; replacement, silent deduplication and silent substitution are false; denominator_may_not_shrink=true. The consumer contract assigns hospital locators to PR-046 and payer locators to PR-049 with typed unresolved bindings. This is an IDs-only frame and does not satisfy R10 locator/disposition or parsed-sample targets.
findings.required_correction: PR-046/049 must consume these IDs without replacement and add per-ID locator/disposition evidence. They must not treat the selection-source URL/hash as an MRF locator or payload result.

findings.observation: The emitted mrf_selection carries the correct no-substitution and denominator flags, but the checked verifier predicates do not assert silent_substitution_allowed=false or denominator_may_not_shrink=true. The c3_lib validator also does not require freeze_before_endpoint_results=true or selection_consumed_not_recomputed=true in assert_pilot_identities; verify.py checks only the freeze flag, counts, consumer PRs, replacement flags and ID uniqueness. A mutated payload could therefore retain a passing producer check while weakening the denominator contract.
findings.required_correction: Extend the final C3 validator/replay checks to assert all immutable MRF contract flags, at minimum freeze_before_endpoint_results, selection_consumed_not_recomputed, silent_substitution_allowed=false and denominator_may_not_shrink=true, plus typed consumer bindings. Keep a negative fixture for each mutation.

findings.observation: The payload acceptance mapping contains exactly R01-R16 and every value is unaccepted. The C3 acceptance overlay preserves the same state in all sixteen markdown rows while updating only the R09/R10 frame descriptions. Producer verification reports ok=true and all 58 checks true, including R-status, C3 family, C3 pilot and C1 projection checks; that producer receipt remains evidence, not independent acceptance.

limitations: The manifest records the source run as cancelled, snapshot_only=true and independently_accepted=false (manifest.json:7-17).

Hospital original CSV bytes are not retained; only the original capture hash/URL and an uncommitted identity projection are available (cohorts.json:source_retention; c3_lib.py:246-253,595-603). This is adequate for the frozen candidate identity review but limits exact later source-row re-resolution.
No publisher/network/provider calls or endpoint results were made; candidate locators remain unverified by design.
No raw holdout prompts or labels were inspected.
required_corrections_summary: Harden the C3 verifier against mutation of no-substitution and denominator-retention flags before final acceptance.
Keep copied publisher/locator fields explicitly candidate/unverified in every downstream publication consumer.
Require PR-046/049 to add actual MRF locator/disposition evidence while retaining all frozen IDs.
